references.name: whole-cannon.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected full side view. Very long pale green patinated bronze barrel,flared thick muzzle collar,closed breech,raised cast bands andseveral rectangular side lifting lugs. Dark decorative cast-metal display carriage witha pair oflarge open-spoked wheels,a high front cheek/trunnion cradle andlower rear trail/small support roller. Low rectangular lightstone platform. Four large dark displayed cannonballs arestacked infront,onepartlyhidden. Original simplified geometric relief canreplace horse/arms/lion faces/lettering. No plaque text reproduction.
